test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If ₹5000 is invested for a period of three years at 20% compound interest per annum, compounded annually, what will be the amount received after 3 years?
solution:
**Given: **

Principle (P) = Rs. 5000 

Rate of interest (R) = 20% per annum 

Time period (T) = 3 years 

**Formula used: **

Amount = P (1 + R/100)T. 

**Calculation: **

Amount = 5000(1 + 20/100)³ 

⇒ 5000 (1 + 1/5)³ 

⇒ 5000 × (6/5)³ 

⇒ 5000 × 216/125 

⇒ 40 × 216 = Rs. 8640.

**∴ The amount received after 3 years will be Rs. 8640.**
